items.title: 61521_David Albert Francis oral history interview
items.q: Leroy Kirkland Curtlin lived in the same building that I lived in.

ctx.x: So if we could skip back now for a minute with the music, we've been through the Cab Calloway scene. Now comes the fifties and the sixties, where the recording thing started, and that was a great era for you, because without a doubt, you were probably one of the most recorded drummers during the fifties and sixties, I dare say -- you had quite a career. How did you get into that, Panama?
Well, Leroy Kirkland Curtlin lived in the same building that I lived in.
He was an arranger and a guitarist?
